title: Yellow Creamy Indian Paneer Tikka
description: A winey, creamy, and flavorful Maharashtrian dish featuring paneer tikka, couscous, and a low-glycemic-friendly braise, perfect for the monsoon season. This recipe combines the richness of Indian spices with the comfort of a warm and creamy sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the onion until it is translucent.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until it is soft and mashed.
Add the curry powder and garam masala and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the paneer cubes and cook until they are lightly browned on all sides.
Add the yogurt and stir well to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the paneer mixture is simmering, cook the couscous according to the package instructions.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and serve with the paneer tikka.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
